offers.name: US Grant Eligibility Audit
offers.headline: Find out which US Federal grants you actually qualify for
offers.body: Most Israeli founders assume Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) money is closed to them, then discover the ownership and place-of-performance rules a year too late. We check your structure against the real eligibility criteria and tell you which programs are open and which are not.
offers.friction_reducer: Written findings in 3 business days. No call required.

match.intent: The founder is asking whether they can access Federal or State funding.

offers.name: Schedule C / 8858 Founder Setup
offers.headline: Get your US filing structure right before the first deadline
offers.body: An Israeli founder with US activity can end up owing Schedule C reporting, Form 8858 for a foreign disregarded entity, or both, and the penalties are assessed per form per year. We map which filings your actual structure triggers and when each one is due.
offers.friction_reducer: Send your structure by email, get a written filing map back.

match.intent: The founder is asking about entity structure, tax filings, or registration.

offers.name: Cross-Border Advisory Call
offers.headline: Talk through your US market entry with someone who has done it from here
offers.body: Fifteen years of business-to-business go-to-market from Israel, including the parts that do not survive the flight to New York. We work through your sequencing, your first hires, and what to stop doing.
offers.friction_reducer: Send the brief first. We only book a call if it is genuinely useful.

match.intent: The founder is asking about commercial strategy rather than compliance.
